Follow these", "m01": "I'd rather not insult the reader's intelligence.", "m02": "Neither is intrinsically better; it depends on how well each is implemented, and mixed economies tend to outperform purist versions of either.", "m03": "I have no secret to reveal, and any I claimed to possess would be a fabrication.", "w01": "The lamp turned slowly above Elias, and the sea kept its own hours. He had kept this light for thirty-one years, and the winter had been long enough that he talked to the gulls. Then the tide brought a bottle, green glass scuffed white, wax still sealing the cork. Inside, a single page, written in a child's careful hand: We are still here. Do not stop the light. There was no name, no date, only a small drawing of a boat and three stick figures. Elias read it twice, then climbed the ninety-two steps and polished the lens until it burned. He never learned who wrote it. He kept the light.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一只刚刚合上眼睛的巨兽。高架桥上的路灯还亮着，光晕在薄雾里散成一圈圈模糊的橘色。环卫工人的扫帚声从街角传来，一下一下，很有耐心。便利店的白光孤零零地亮着，一个穿西装的人坐在窗边吃关东煮。远处的写字楼还有几格窗子没睡，像被遗忘的屏幕。天边开始泛出极淡的青色，像宣纸上不小心洇开的一滴水。城市在那一点青色里，慢慢重新学会呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves a small piece of itself, then hands the rest to a copy of itself.\n- Every copy must get a little smaller, like opening nesting dolls until you reach the tiniest one.\n- That tiniest doll is the stopping rule—without it, the copies would go on forever and never finish."}
